caption: AI drafts can sound convincing yet be wrong. Use this five-prompt QA routine to verify accuracy and sources. Which prompt will you run first to audit AI work today? #AIforBusiness #ProductivityHacks #Founders

slides.title: Your AI checks mislead you
slides.body: People trust AI drafts that sound right but miss checks. Here are five prompts to verify accuracy and context.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose quality
slides.body: Task: assess AI answer accuracy for {topic}. Input: {ai_output}. Output: list errors with severity and brief fix.

slides.title: 2. Improve context
slides.body: Task: surface hidden constraints and source requirements in the {topic}. Input: {ai_output}. Output: revised answer with constraints enumerated.

slides.title: 3. Verify sources
slides.body: Task: extract claimed data from {ai_output} and check against sources. Input: {ai_output}. Output: list sources with URL or note 'unverified'.

slides.title: 4. Edge cases
slides.body: Task: test {ai_output} against edge cases relevant to {topic}. Input: {ai_output}. Output: a short table of scenarios and results.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Task: propose a reusable QA workflow for checking AI work. Input: {topic}. Output: step-by-step checklist with decision points.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Final payoff: validate AI work with the five prompts to reduce errors and save time on decisions.
